pdf_page_count fails when the supplied password does not authenticate the document

```python title="Python"
from pathlib import Path
from xberg import pdf_page_count
from xberg import XbergError

def main() -> None:
    try:
        pdf_bytes = Path("pdf/password_protected.pdf").read_bytes()
        password = "xberg-test-fake-wrong-password-1879"
        pdf_page_count(pdf_bytes, password)
    except XbergError as error:
        print(f"{type(error).__name__}: {error}")

main()
```
